diagnosis: Customer is asking about deprecation timeline for v1 reporting endpoints. They are on business plan with standard support. KB-0007 directly answers their question with specific retirement date and migration path.
reply: The v1 reporting endpoints will stop accepting traffic on November 1, 2026. We recommend migrating to the v2 reporting endpoints, which return the same fields under a paginated envelope. If you need assistance with the migration, let us know and we can connect you with resources.
